weatherMsg.msg: Aufheben splits the sky with a blinding light.
After destruction comes judgment. With the party's thesis and antithesis debuffs out of balance, a random party member will be KO'd.
Ashray's will has temporarily suppressed Aufheben.
Aufheben will soon cast Light's End.
The force of destruction is accelerating. If you don't pair up with another party member who has a different thesis debuff from you, you'll be KO'd in 10 seconds.
